items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: The interviewee does not respond to the interviewer's question about knowing Charlie Love, instead changing the subject to other musicians (Piron, Joe Burgess, Jimmy Dupree).

ctx.x: Well, yeah, Al Minetta, yeah. He played violin. He played violin, played well. And Bocas played violin, too. Yeah, I was going to say, I thought that Pete played violin as well. Still does. Uh-huh.

And do you know Charlie Love? He's a trumpet player from all that college, you know what, anyway? I don't remember. He and Bocas made some records where Bocas plays the violin and Love plays the trumpet. And they played some of the Red Book ragtime arrangements like Maple Leaf and-

What was the name of this violin player that used to play out at Tranchinas years ago? Piron. Piron. I'll never forget, Piron recorded a number that an old friend of mine wrote. I used to write some tunes with him. Joe Burgess and- Oh, yeah. I know Joe Burgess. Jimmy Dupree. Jimmy Dupree and I used to write songs together.
